name: Articuno
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

locations.area: Roaming Sinnoh (talk to Prof. Oak in Eterna City)
locations.conditions: Post-Dex: obtain National Dex, speak to Oak in Eterna | NPC: Prof. Oak in Eterna City

howToObtain: Found in the wild (see locations below)

encounters.location: Roaming Sinnoh (talk to Prof. Oak in Eterna City)
encounters.notes: Post-Dex: obtain National Dex, speak to Oak in Eterna | NPC: Prof. Oak in Eterna City

legendary.location: Roaming Sinnoh (talk to Prof. Oak in Eterna City)
legendary.requirement: Post-Dex: obtain National Dex, speak to Oak in Eterna

levelUp.name: Gust
levelUp.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the foe to inflict damage.

levelUp.name: Powder Snow
levelUp.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the target.

levelUp.name: Mist
levelUp.description: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

levelUp.name: Ice Shard
levelUp.description: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

levelUp.name: Mind Reader
levelUp.description: The user senses the foe’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss.

levelUp.name: AncientPower
levelUp.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

levelUp.name: Agility
levelUp.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

levelUp.name: Ice Beam
levelUp.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

levelUp.name: Reflect
levelUp.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

levelUp.name: Roost
levelUp.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

levelUp.name: Tailwind
levelUp.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

levelUp.name: Blizzard, Signal Beam, Hidden Power, Swagger
Blizzard
levelUp.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

levelUp.name: Sheer Cold
levelUp.description: The foe is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The foe instantly faints if it hits.

levelUp.name: Hail
levelUp.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

tmHm.name: Water Pulse
tmHm.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

tmHm.name: Roar
tmHm.description: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Hail
tmHm.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Ice Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Blizzard
tmHm.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

tmHm.name: Hyper Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Rain Dance
tmHm.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Reflect
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Sandstorm
tmHm.description: A five-turn sand- storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock,  Ground, and Steel.

tmHm.name: Aerial Ace
tmHm.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Steel Wing
tmHm.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

tmHm.name: Roost
tmHm.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Giga Impact
tmHm.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Avalanche
tmHm.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Pluck
tmHm.description: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

tmHm.name: U-turn
tmHm.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Fly
tmHm.description: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

tmHm.name: Defog
tmHm.description: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.

tmHm.name: Rock Smash
tmHm.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

tutor.name: Mud-Slap
tutor.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

tutor.name: Icy Wind
tutor.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tutor.name: Ominous Wind
tutor.description: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Air Cutter
tutor.description: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tutor.name: AncientPower
tutor.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

tutor.name: Signal Beam
tutor.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

tutor.name: Twister
tutor.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Swift
tutor.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.
